name: Query Type 3 Code
definition: Specifies the nature of the request, that is whether all information be returned or only information that has changed since the last similar request was returned.

ALLL.name: All
ALLL.definition: Specifies that the query requests that all matching items be returned.

CHNG.name: Changed
CHNG.definition: Specifies that the query requests that only new matching items since the last similar query be returned.

MODF.name: Modified
MODF.definition: Specifies that the query requests that only items that have changed since the last query be returned.
